title: Middle slice
description: Write a function `middle(items)` that returns every element except the first and the last, as a list.
hints: Slicing lets you take a range of a list using `items[start:end]`.
Start at index 1 (skip the first) and stop at index -1 (exclude the last).
expected_behavior: Returns a new list without its first and last elements.
explanation: Slicing `items[1:-1]` starts right after the first element and stops right before the last one, since slice ends are exclusive.
